set_value.name: player.entity.$AdvancedTargetingHotkeysConfig
set_value.exact: table[ $groupCombatEnabled = true, $groupFleetEnabled = true, $groupNavigationEnabled = true, $groupResourcesEnabled = true, $groupSurfaceEnabled = true, $groupMissionEnabled = true, $rangeMultiplier = 2, $soundEnabled = true, $notifyOnFailure = true, $notifyOnTypeFilter = true, $stickyModeEnabled = true, $preferVisibleOnLoss = true, $dockableScanLimit = 12, $targetingBackend = 'lua', ]

set_value.name: player.entity.$AdvancedTargetingHotkeysState
set_value.exact: table[ $mode = null, $macroFilter = null, $surfaceMode = null, $surfaceParent = null, $surfaceTarget = null, $selfChange = false, $shiftPending = false, $shiftTarget = null, $shiftApplied = null, $shiftAt = 0s, ]

do_if.value: $autoShiftMode == 'enemyAll' or $autoShiftMode == 'enemySmall' or $autoShiftMode == 'enemyLarge' or $autoShiftMode == 'missiles' or $autoShiftMode == 'collectables' or $autoShiftMode == 'surfaceAll' or $autoShiftMode == 'surfaceEngines' or $autoShiftMode == 'surfaceTurrets' or $autoShiftMode == 'surfaceShields'

$candidate.isplayerowned or ($candidate.isradarvisible and $candidate.distanceto.{player.entity} le $radar) or ($candidate.iscapitalship and $candidate.distanceto.{player.entity} le $farRadar) or $candidate.isclass.station or $candidate.isclass.gate or $candidate.isclass.highwayentrygate

debug_text.text: 'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: surface parent %s yielded %s candidates for mode %s'.[$parent.debugname, $candidates.count, $mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: hull %s has no %s left, offering the hull itself'.[$parent.debugname, $mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: no usable surface hull for mode %s, target %s'.[$mode, @player.target.debugname]

find_object.name: $found
find_object.class: [class.ship, class.station, class.highwayentrygate, class.gate, class.collectablewares, class.asteroid, class.missile, class.mine, class.explosive, class.lockbox, class.navbeacon, class.resourceprobe, class.satellite]

debug_text.text: 'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: applying target %s, mode %s, backend %s'.[$thing.debugname, $mode, $config.$targetingBackend]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: target %s is already selected, no change to raise'.[$thing.debugname]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: nothing matched for mode %s, target left unchanged'.[$mode]

'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: registering actions, groups combat %s fleet %s navigation %s resources %s surface %s mission %s'.[ $config.$groupCombatEnabled, $config.$groupFleetEnabled, $config.$groupNavigationEnabled, $config.$groupResourcesEnabled, $config.$groupSurfaceEnabled, $config.$groupMissionEnabled]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: acquire id %s, mode %s'.[$id, $mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: cycle id %s, mode %s, %s candidates'.[$id, $mode, $candidates.count]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: cycle stepped from index %s of %s'.[$index, $candidates.count]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: deselect, clearing mode %s'.[$state.$mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: type filter pinned to %s from %s, mode %s'.[$macroName, player.target.debugname, $mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: type filter needs a selection made by a filtered hotkey - mode %s, target %s'.[$mode, @player.target.debugname]

find_object.name: $found
find_object.class: [class.ship, class.station, class.highwayentrygate, class.gate, class.collectablewares, class.asteroid, class.missile, class.mine, class.explosive, class.lockbox, class.navbeacon, class.resourceprobe, class.satellite]

debug_text.text: 'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: line of sight pass %s at %s, found %s'.[$pass, $angle, @$thing.debugname]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: target changed to %s, ours: %s, mode %s'.[@event.param.debugname, $state.$selfChange, $state.$mode]

'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: changed detail - t %s, issurface %s, sTarget %s, sParent %s, sMode %s, age %s'.[@event.param.debugname, @event.param.issurfaceelement, @$state.$surfaceTarget.debugname, @$state.$surfaceParent.debugname, $state.$surfaceMode, player.age]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shift landed on %s, releasing hold on mode %s'.[@event.param.debugname, $state.$mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shift pending, applying %s on target change to %s, mode %s'.[$thing.debugname, @event.param.debugname, $mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shift target %s was already selected, releasing hold on mode %s'.[$thing.debugname, $state.$mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shift target %s already picked by the engine, holding for its event, mode %s'.[$thing.debugname, $state.$mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shift landed on %s, releasing hold on mode %s'.[@event.param.debugname, $state.$mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shift pending, ignoring target change to %s, holding mode %s'.[@event.param.debugname, $state.$mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: branch - surface element lost, was %s on hull %s, keeping mode %s'.[@$state.$surfaceTarget.debugname, @$state.$surfaceParent.debugname, $state.$surfaceMode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: branch - target cleared externally with no surface state, resetting mode'
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: branch - external surface pick, entering surface mode'
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: branch - external object pick, resetting mode'
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: tracked target %s lost via %s, by %s, mode %s'.[@event.object.debugname, event.name, @event.param.debugname, $state.$mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: lost %s is index %s of %s candidates, mode %s'.[@event.object.debugname, $index, $candidates.count, $mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: target still matches mode %s after %s, no shift'.[$mode, event.name]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: visibility walk starting at slot %s of %s, next by index is %s'.[$startSlot, $candidates.count, $thing.debugname]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: visibility walk skipped %s blocked, picked %s at slot %s'.[$hidden, $visiblePick.debugname, $pickSlot]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: visibility walk found nothing in sight after a full round, keeping next by index %s'.[$thing.debugname]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: no %s left on hull %s, falling back to the hull itself'.[$mode, $state.$surfaceParent.debugname]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shifting to %s, mode %s, %s candidates'.[$thing.debugname, $mode, $candidates.count]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: queueing shift to %s, mode %s'.[$thing.debugname, $mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: nothing left to shift to for mode %s, leaving target alone'.[$mode]
'AdvancedTargetingHotkeys: shift skipped, mode %s does not auto-shift'.[$mode]
